title: tarja: entity spec / spec de entidade
description: EN: schema for entity yaml files. PT: schema dos yaml de entidade.

id.description: EN: entity code, BR_ prefix (Presidio convention), e.g. BR_CPF. PT: codigo da entidade, prefixo BR_ (padrao Presidio). Ex: BR_CPF.

name.description: EN: short name, e.g. CPF. PT: nome curto. Ex: CPF.

description.description: EN: description in UK English. PT: descricao em ingles UK.

country_code.description: EN: always br. PT: sempre br.

tier.description: EN: N1 strong check digit, N2 format only, N3 context-dependent, N4 NER. PT: N1 DV forte, N2 so formato, N3 depende de contexto, N4 NER.

status.description: EN: experimental -> beta -> stable. PT: experimental -> beta -> stable.

since.description: EN: version the entity was added in. PT: versao em q a entidade entrou.

lgpd.description: EN: category under the LGPD (Brazil's data protection law). PT: categoria na LGPD.

patterns.description: EN: candidate regexes. Score here is BEFORE the check digit is validated. PT: regex de candidatos. Score aqui e ANTES de validar o DV.

dlp_portable.description: EN: can the check digit be reproduced inside each DLP? fill in at E5.1. PT: da p/ reproduzir o DV em cada DLP? preencher no E5.1.

validator.description: EN: check-digit function (python path) + algorithm summary. null if the entity has no check digit. PT: funcao de DV (caminho python) + resumo do algoritmo. null se nao tiver DV.

context.description: EN: words that raise the score when nearby (window in characters). Words are in Portuguese on purpose: they are matched against Brazilian text. PT: palavras q sobem o score se estao perto (janela em caracteres). Ficam em PT de proposito, pq sao buscadas em texto BR.

score.description: EN: final score after check-digit validation. PT: score final depois de validar o DV.

sources.description: EN: official standard for the algorithm. Mandatory. PT: norma oficial do algoritmo. Obrigatorio.

examples.description: EN: examples used in the tests (never real data). PT: exemplos usados nos testes (nunca dado real).

description_pt.description: PT: descricao em pt-BR (a 'description' fica em EN-UK)

$comment: EN: one yaml per entity in spec/entities/. Drives the lib, the Presidio plugin, DLP exports and docs. PT: 1 yaml por entidade em spec/entities/. Daqui sai lib, plugin presidio, export p/ DLP e docs. Author/autoria: https://github.com/macmaia
